title: Preparation-protocol-dependent quantum Mpemba dynamics in a magnetically tunable graphene nanotorus qubit
summary: We investigate the quantum Mpemba effect in a graphene nanotorus qubit and show that its strength depends strongly on how the initial state is prepared. We compare two protocols that share the same final Hamiltonian, thermal bath, and Markovian Liouvillian: bare Gibbs preparation, in which the coherent drive is switched on only at the final quench, and driven steady-state preparation, in which the initial states are stationary states of the driven dynamics.
